title: Text-to-organism design
headline: New assignment from the hub: sim-engine/, our own simulation backend as an MCP server, v1 runs with 5 tools and 21 passing tests. Its first pre-registered test FAILED and that is the result worth reporting: a single-morphogen threshold model predicts the WRONG AXIS for the hhip fin phenotype. Measured is dorsoventral +50 percent with anteroposterior unchanged; the model puts all its growth on the anteroposterior axis, because a ZPA drawn as a posterior strip spanning the bud height leaves no room to grow dorsoventrally. Nothing was tuned afterwards. The organism thread work is unchanged and still live: ten blueprints, 35 unsigned records.
needs: The key owner to decide on signing and the test registry; nothing is signed, published, or names a person

Someone to carry organism-design/nanopubs/UPSTREAM-ASK.md to Knowledge Pixels: republish three migrated templates, migrate two, fix the checker exit code, and consider two assessment templates the holdout thread proposed

A decision on whether the failed hhip prediction should be written up as a nanopub record: it is a negative result about our own model, and those are the easiest to leave unpublished
